repairs.correction: 시전자 적중; 형상 제한 제거; bonusHealth; 잔량 없음; 전용 가속 텍스트와 1당 1% 역할; 사망 조건 정정
repairs.quote: Passive: Shyvana generates 1.25 Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by 200% while in Dragon Form, and reduced 75% by when striking in an area against non-champions. Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and causing them Flee for 0.75 seconds. While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains 150/250/350 bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining. Shyvana gains 1% increased Fury from all sources per 1 Ultimate Ability Haste. Ultimate Haste acquired while dead does not take effect until Shyvana revives.

proposalDecisions.reason: bonus Health에 대응하는 bonusHealth 키가 존재하므로 maxHealth에서 bonusHealth로 수정.
가속 1을 ratio_input, 증가율 1%를 ratio_output으로 교정; 전용 궁극기 가속은 텍스트로 보존.
